versions.changelog:
xhs-data 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides dual engine architecture for Xiaohongshu data scraping: API (RedCrack Python reverse engineering) and browser automation (Selenium/Playwright).
- Supports note extraction, user homepage crawling with scrolling, keyword search, comment retrieval, and media (image, video) downloads.
- Automatically handles encrypted parameters, anti-scraping challenges, and supports proxy configuration.
- Enforces safety limits, stores results in organized directories, and fetches only public content.
- Includes usage examples and recommendations for safe operation.
